title: 9 Best Herbal Creams For Hemorrhoids
intro: Herbal creams for Hemorrhoids are topical creams or ointments made from natural herbs that provide relief from the symptoms of hemorrhoids. These creams are beneficial as they reduce swelling, itching, and pain associated with hemorrhoids, allowing for a faster recovery. Examples of herbal creams used to treat hemorrhoids include Witch Hazel cream, which soothes and calms the affected area, Aloe Vera cream, which has anti-inflammatory properties to reduce swelling, and Tea Tree Oil cream, which has antibacterial properties to prevent infections. Other herbal creams, such as Chamomile, Epsom Salt, and Calendula, also offer relief from hemorrhoid symptoms due to their soothing and anti-inflammatory properties, making them a popular choice for natural treatment.

preparations.preparation_desc: Hamamelis virginiana creams, derived from the witch hazel plant, have been traditionally used to treat hemorrhoids due to their anti-inflammatory and astringent properties, which help to reduce swelling and promote healing. The bioactive constituents of Hamamelis virginiana, including tannins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, are responsible for its therapeutic effects, which help to soothe and calm irritated tissues. By reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing, Hamamelis virginiana creams can provide relief from the pain, itching, and discomfort associated with hemorrhoids. The benefits of using Hamamelis virginiana creams to treat hemorrhoids include reduced bleeding, improved wound healing, and a decrease in the risk of infection, making it a popular natural remedy for this common condition.

preparations.preparation_study: According to "Journal of integrative medicine", Aloe barbadensis creams for hemorrhoids show potential as a treatment option due to its properties being mentioned as one of the 37 medicinal plants with hemorrhoid-healing effects in Iranian traditional medicine.
